responsibility: Assembles the crate’s baked ICU data module by including the generated macro definitions, defining the macros that install all per-key and any-provider implementations, and declaring `BakedDataProvider` as the concrete provider exposing this module’s baked data set.
same_name_distinction: Unlike all other same-named files, which either group a specific subtree or provide one dataset’s lookup function, this top-level `mod.rs` is the crate-wide entry point: it ties the submodules together and defines the provider-implementation macros plus `BakedDataProvider` that dispatches across all baked keys.
